applicabilityBasis.summary: USDKG was marketed as an issuer-redeemable, USD-referenced token with a 1:1 U.S. dollar peg for cross-border payments on Ethereum and TRON, backed by physical gold. Gold is the collateral, not the promised unit of account, so the securities/commodity-token exclusion is not established. The current issuer website announces termination of all activities, including blockchain operations, under Kyrgyz Cabinet order 639-t dated August 20, 2026, and directs holders to contact the issuer to exchange tokens for fiat or USDT.

genius.notes: USDKG was marketed as a 1:1 USD-referenced payment and settlement token redeemable for gold, USD or cryptocurrencies. The current homepage states that operations, including blockchain activities, are ceasing under a Kyrgyz Cabinet order and offers email-based exchange for fiat or USDT. This does not establish an unconditional current par-redemption policy. The November 2025 issuer announcement names OJSC Virtual Asset Issuer as issuer and Gold Dollar as reserve operator; the November 2025 Kreston report identifies LLC Virelint Group as a management/collateral contractor. issuerEntity is corrected from a compound issuer/operator narrative to the issuer name alone. The publicly available November 2025 report is historical agreed-upon-procedures evidence, without an assurance opinion; reserveDisclosurePresent records document availability, not current reserve sufficiency. Current licensing, comprehensive U.S. enforcement clearance and a current monthly attestation series are not established, so those optional assertions are omitted. No GENIUS-specific approval, official application or registered foreign exception was found in the dated public-source review. The pre-effective DASP status concerns GENIUS timing only and does not certify unrestricted distribution or override the issuer wind-down.

negativeEvidenceReview.summary: As of October 7, 2026, the reviewed OCC pending-application table, zero-result Federal Register exact-name query, NYDFS roster/Greenlist, general federal implementing proposals and issuer disclosures did not identify a USDKG / OJSC Virtual Asset Issuer-specific GENIUS PPSI approval, state-qualified authorization, official GENIUS application or registered foreign-issuer exception. Gold Dollar and Virelint operator names were included in the public searches without substituting them for the legal issuer. Generic regulatory-design commentary and a historical Hong Kong listing do not establish U.S. permission. This is a bounded public-source negative finding; confidential or unpublished filings are not ruled out.
